description: This viral Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread combines a delightful harmony of sweet and savory flavors. Soft, fluffy bread rolls are deeply cut, filled with a luscious sweet cream cheese, and then drenched in a rich, aromatic garlic butter sauce. Baked to golden perfection, each bite offers an irresistible blend of creamy, buttery, and garlicky goodness that is truly addictive.

instructions.title: Prepare the Bread
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 160°C (325°F). Take each soft bread roll and make 6-8 deep cuts from the top, without cutting all the way through the bottom, creating a star or flower shape.

instructions.title: Make Cream Cheese Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, granulated sugar, and heavy cream or milk. Mix until smooth and creamy. Transfer this mixture into a piping bag or a ziplock bag with a corner snipped off.

instructions.title: Prepare Garlic Butter Glaze
instructions.text: In another bowl, melt the unsalted butter. Add the minced garlic, finely chopped fresh parsley, egg yolk, sweetened condensed milk, and milk. Whisk until all ingredients are well combined and the glaze is smooth.

instructions.title: Fill the Bread
instructions.text: Carefully pipe the cream cheese filling into each cut of the bread rolls, ensuring an even distribution. You want each crevice to be generously filled with the sweet cream cheese.

instructions.title: Dip in Garlic Butter
instructions.text: Gently pick up each filled bread roll and dip it into the garlic butter glaze. Make sure the glaze seeps into all the cuts and coats the entire surface of the bread. You can also spoon the glaze over the top if dipping is too messy.

instructions.title: Bake to Perfection
instructions.text: Place the glazed bread rolls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the garlic butter is bubbling.

instructions.title: Serve Warm
instructions.text: Once baked, remove the Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread from the oven. Let it cool for a few minutes before serving. Garnish with a sprinkle of extra fresh parsley if desired, and enjoy warm for the best experience.

tips: For the softest bread, use brioche buns or good quality dinner rolls that are already slightly sweet. This provides the perfect base for the rich fillings.
Adjust the sweetness of the cream cheese filling and garlic butter glaze to your preference. You can add more or less sugar or condensed milk.
This bread is best served warm, fresh out of the oven. If you have leftovers, reheat them briefly in a toaster oven or microwave for a few seconds to restore their warmth and softness.
article:
Unlock a world of irresistible flavors with a dish that has taken the internet by storm and captured the hearts of foodies worldwide: Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread. This sensational creation is a testament to the innovative spirit of Korean baking, blending familiar comfort with an exciting new twist. Far from your average garlic bread, this Korean specialty offers a symphony of tastes and textures – a perfect harmony of sweet, savory, creamy, and undeniably garlicky. If you're ready to elevate your baking game and impress your taste buds, join us on a culinary journey to master this iconic treat.

## What is Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread?

Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is a popular street food and bakery item originating from South Korea, where it’s known as "Mar-neul-bbang" (garlic bread) but with a distinct creamy filling. Unlike its Western counterpart, which is typically savory and served as a side dish, the Korean version is a standalone star. It starts with a soft, often brioche-like bun or roll, which is deeply scored into wedges. These wedges are then generously filled with a slightly sweetened cream cheese mixture. The entire bread is then dipped or brushed lavishly with a rich, aromatic garlic butter sauce, often containing honey or sugar, before being baked until golden and fragrant. The result is an explosion of flavors: the pungent kick of garlic, the rich sweetness of butter and honey, and the cool, tangy creaminess of the cheese, all encased in a tender, slightly crisp bread. It's a truly unique and addictive experience, embodying the best of Korean baking innovation.

## Ingredients You'll Need

To embark on your Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread adventure, gather these essential ingredients. Quality matters here, especially for the bread and dairy components.

For the Bread:
*   6 soft round bread rolls (e.g., brioche buns, milk bread buns, or even a soft French baguette cut into rounds)

For the Cream Cheese Filling:
*   8 oz (226g) full-fat cream cheese, softened
*   2-3 tbsp granulated sugar (adjust to your sweetness preference)
*   1 large egg yolk
*   1 tbsp heavy cream or milk

For the Garlic Butter Glaze:
*   ½ cup (113g) unsalted butter, melted
*   6-8 cloves garlic, freshly minced (about 2-3 tbsp)
*   2 tbsp granulated sugar or honey (or a mix)
*   1 large egg
*   2 tbsp mayonnaise
*   1 tbsp dried parsley flakes (for garnish and flavor)
*   A pinch of salt

## Step-by-Step Instructions

Follow these steps carefully to create your perfect Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread.

1.  **Prepare the Bread:** If using round rolls, use a sharp knife to cut each roll into 6 or 8 equal wedges, cutting about ¾ of the way through, but not all the way to the bottom. This creates pockets for the filling. If using a baguette, slice it into 1-inch thick rounds and then score each round.
2.  **Make the Cream Cheese Filling:** In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, sugar, egg yolk, and heavy cream. Whisk until the mixture is smooth, creamy, and lump-free. Transfer this filling into a piping bag fitted with a round tip (or a zip-top bag with a corner snipped off).
3.  **Fill the Bread:** Carefully open the scored wedges of each bread roll and generously pipe the cream cheese filling into each crevice. Don't be shy – the more filling, the better the experience.
4.  **Prepare the Garlic Butter Glaze:** In another bowl, combine the melted butter, minced garlic, sugar/honey, egg, mayonnaise, and salt. Whisk vigorously until all ingredients are well combined and the mixture is emulsified. Stir in the dried parsley flakes.
5.  **Glaze the Bread:** Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Dip each filled bread roll entirely into the garlic butter glaze, ensuring all sides and crevices are thoroughly coated. You can also use a brush to slather the glaze on generously if dipping is too messy. Place the glazed rolls onto the prepared baking sheet.
6.  **Bake:** Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown, the garlic is fragrant, and the cream cheese filling is slightly puffed and warm. Keep an eye on it to prevent burning.
7.  **Serve:** Let the Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread cool for a few minutes before serving. It's best enjoyed warm.

## Pro Tips for the Best Results

Achieving bakery-quality Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is all about the details.

*   **Choose the Right Bread:** A soft, slightly sweet bread like brioche or milk bread works best. Its tender crumb perfectly complements the rich fillings. Stale bread can be too dry.
*   **Don't Skimp on Garlic:** Freshly minced garlic is crucial for that authentic pungent aroma and flavor. Avoid pre-minced garlic if possible.
*   **Embrace the Sweetness:** The slight sweetness in both the cream cheese and garlic butter is what truly defines this Korean treat. Don't be afraid to adjust sugar/honey to your preference.
*   **Score Deeply, But Not Through:** Ensure your cuts are deep enough to create substantial pockets for the cream cheese, but not so deep that the bread falls apart. About ¾ of the way is ideal.
*   **Generous Glazing:** The garlic butter glaze is the heart of the flavor. Be extremely generous when dipping or brushing; the bread should be saturated with it.
*   **Watch Your Oven:** Ovens vary, so keep an eye on your bread. You want a golden-brown exterior and a warmed-through interior without over-browning the garlic.
*   **Serve Warm:** This bread is absolutely at its peak when served warm, allowing the cream cheese to be gooey and the garlic butter to be aromatic.

## Serving Suggestions

Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is incredibly versatile and can be enjoyed in various ways. It’s perfect as:

*   **A Standalone Snack:** Its rich and satisfying nature makes it a fantastic treat on its own, especially with a cup of coffee or tea.
*   **Brunch Item:** Elevate your weekend brunch spread with this unique and delicious bread.
*   **Party Appetizer:** Cut into smaller pieces, it makes an impressive and crowd-pleasing appetizer for gatherings.
*   **Dessert Alternative:** While savory, its sweetness can make it a delightful end to a meal, especially for those who prefer less traditional desserts.

## Variations and Substitutions

Feel free to get creative with your Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread!

*   **Spicy Kick:** Add a pinch of red pepper flakes to the garlic butter glaze for a subtle heat.
*   **Herbal Infusion:** Experiment with fresh herbs like chives or basil mixed into the cream cheese filling, or rosemary added to the garlic butter.
*   **Cheese Please:** A sprinkle of mozzarella or Parmesan on top during the last few minutes of baking can add another layer of savory goodness.
*   **Vegan Option:** Use plant-based cream cheese, vegan butter, and an egg substitute (like flax egg or commercial egg replacer) to make a delicious vegan version.
*   **Gluten-Free:** Opt for your favorite gluten-free bread rolls to make this recipe accessible to all.
*   **Different Breads:** While round buns are traditional, you can try this with a small loaf of ciabatta, focaccia, or even thick slices of Texas toast for a different texture.

## Storage Tips

If you happen to have any leftovers of this delectable Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread, proper storage will help maintain its deliciousness.

*   **Cool Completely:** Allow the bread to cool completely to room temperature before storing.
*   **Airtight Container:** Store the bread in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1-2 days. For longer storage, you can refrigerate it for up to 3-4 days.
*   **Reheating:** To reheat, place the bread in a preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for about 5-10 minutes, or until warmed through and the cheese is soft again. Avoid microwaving, as it can make the bread soggy. Freezing is generally not recommended as the texture of the cream cheese can change upon thawing.

Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is more than just a recipe; it's an experience. Its unique blend of flavors and textures makes it an unforgettable treat that perfectly showcases the creativity of Korean baking. Whether you're a seasoned baker or a curious foodie, this recipe promises a rewarding culinary adventure. So, roll up your sleeves, gather your ingredients, and prepare to delight your senses with this truly exceptional bread. Enjoy every sweet, savory, and garlicky bite!
